eventMetadata.context_description: Iowa State's dominant Big 12 pedigree and top-20 ranking form the core driver behind the 97.4% trader consensus, reflecting a stark talent chasm against mid-major Ohio Valley Conference foe Tennessee State, who enter with a sub-.500 record and defensive woes allowing 80+ points routinely. Recent developments cement this: Iowa State's starters are fully healthy per official reports, riding a seven-game win streak with elite perimeter defense holding opponents under 40% shooting, while TSU's leading scorer is questionable with a hamstring strain. Historical data shows power-conference teams winning 98% of similar cross-over clashes by double digits. Realistic wildcards include an improbable TSU three-point barrage or Iowa State rust from a long layoff, though both remain low-probability shocks in this mismatch.
